The controversy continues to unfold across livestreams and social media.

articles.title: South Carolina family permanently protects 2,000-acre farm from development in historic deal
articles.description: A family in South Carolina has successfully established a conservation easement to safeguard 2,000 acres of Creekland Farms from future development. Nestled in the rapidly expanding Laurens County, this agreement not only preserves the land's agricultural and recreational uses but also links it to the neighboring Sumter National Forest. It illustrates a proactive strategy in managing urban growth while cherishing rural landscapes.

articles.title: Scotch whisky gets cheaper in India after trade deal with US; check new prices
articles.description: Under the India-UK agreement, the import tariff on British whisky was reduced to 75% from 150%, effectively cutting the rate by half. articles.description: Each year, the senior citizen reported the interest earned from his investments in tax-free bonds under the ‘exempt income’ category in his income tax return (ITR). He therefore approached the jurisdictional assessing officer (JAO) and filed a rectification application.

articles.title: Piyush Goyal gets a ‘trade minister for life’ tag from US trade chief at G20
articles.description: At the G20 trade ministers' meeting in Milwaukee, US trade representative Jamieson Greer discussed key trade issues with Indian minister Piyush Goyal. They focused on food security, steel overcapacity, and the Most-Favoured-Nation principle, which Greer suggested re-examining. Goyal emphasized the importance of distinguishing between legitimate measures and the weaponization of food supply chains. Discussions also included efforts toward finalizing an interim India-US Bilateral Trade Agreement, enhancing cooperation in manufacturing.

articles.title: Five Indiana engineering students built a 12-hour wearable that helps visually impaired users detect obstacles beyond a cane or guide dog
articles.description: Rose-Hulman students have developed a remarkable wearable device tailored for visually impaired individuals. This innovative headgear employs advanced sensors to identify surrounding obstacles, providing users with haptic feedback. With a remarkable twelve-hour battery life on a single charge, this device empowers users with greater independence. The project's goal is to enhance the day-to-day experiences of those with vision impairments.

articles.title: 'Baththa' X review: Vijay's performance wins praise
articles.description: Vijay Sethupathi's 'Baththa' has been praised for standout performances, especially by Vijay and young talent Sabari. With direction by Balaji Tharaneetharan, the film captures the deep connection between a gangster and an innocent boy. The emotional depth is beautifully complemented by Sai Abhyankkar's soundtrack. However, some audiences felt the film's length and slow pace could have been tightened. In essence, 'Baththa' delivers a compelling story that resonates.

articles.title: Rihanna's house shooter indicted for 'attempted murder'
articles.description: Ivanna Lisette Ortiz has been indicted on multiple felony counts, including attempted murder, related to a shooting incident. The incident occurred in March when Ortiz fired a rifle at the home of Rihanna and A$AP Rocky. No injuries were reported during the incident, although their children and staff were present. Ortiz faced a psychological evaluation which confirmed her competency to stand trial.

articles.title: Radhikka Madan calls out quick judgments on women when relationships fail
articles.description: Radhikka Madan has opened up about her role as Sailee in 'Lust Stories 3', revealing why she was drawn to Shakun Batra’s script and the character’s flaws. In an interview with Mid-Day, the actor discussed women’s desire, the scrutiny women face when relationships fall apart and the changing portrayal of female characters in cinema. Madan also explained why she avoids roles that reduce women to objects, saying she would not play parts where women are treated like “furniture.”
